verdict.rationale: Vercel publishes an Enterprise Service Level Agreement at vercel.com/legal/sla. It commits to 99.99% availability, excluding defined Excused Downtime, and states that customers receive a Credit calculated under Section 3 if the Services Level is missed. missing for 10: the actual credit tiers/percentages from Section 3 are not quoted in the evidence, the SLA is scoped to Enterprise subscriptions only, and there is no independent corroboration of how credits are honored.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can review a published uptime SLA with defined credits for downtime

citations.quote: available 99.99% of the time, excluding any Excused Downtime events, as defined below ('Services Level')
If the Services fail to meet the above Services Level, you will receive a Credit equal to the result of the Services Credit calculation in Section 3 of this SLA.
